author: AiriLife-ai+znq19
description: Lets the bot inspect and manage KiraAI on its own: one compact tool set covering plugins, skills, providers, MCP, sessions, personas, configs, logs and the store, guarded by access lists, capability levels and password approval for over-level actions. Every write is snapshotted and audited, with a full WebUI panel.

zh.description: 让 bot 自己查看和管理 KiraAI：一套合并工具覆盖插件、技能、Provider、MCP、会话、人设、配置、日志与商店，带名单/档位权限与超档密码授权。写操作自动备份可回滚、全程审计，另附完整 WebUI 面板。
